basic_info.description: Welcome home to the Beacon. This modern high-rise offers city style living w/the perfect blend of accessibility, commutability, & quality in SF’s sought-afterMission Bay neighborhood. Right across from the Giant's Stadium & the bay. This light-filled 1 bed 1 bath condo offers an open floor plan w/a spacious &airy living room, large bedroom w/walk-in closet & a den area – perfect for a home office. Enjoy the open kitchen w/SS appliances & granite counters, hardwood floors, in-unit laundry & easy-access 1-car parking. The Beacon is a full-service building w/countless amenities such as a 24/7 concierge, business center, outdoor heated lap-pool & spa, fitness center, clubhouse, & dog park. PLUS, convenient grocery right downstairs. Walking distance to Embarcadero, Mission Bay, South Beach parks, high-end & casual restaurants, bars, entertainment, fitness classes, salons/barbers, & Oracle Park. Easy access to the Bay Bridge, 280/101, BART, Caltrain, MUNI, Ferry Building, SOMA and FiDi.
